note: This tree is the source for the public host cluster. Do not attach a Worker to spwashi.com. Do not mention infrastructure ownership in public HTML.

serving.note: How each host answers (2026-11-11). A fixed answer is a file, served at the edge without running code; the worker runs for what computes. files: the assets layer answers everything and the worker runs only for its declared exceptions (or never). mixed: the worker runs first, with declared file exceptions. script: the worker answers everything. check:workers holds each unit's wrangler config to its tier. A held name never redirects to spwashi.com, since public HTML must not show ownership; its next step is a file-only worker of its own. www to each apex belongs to a Redirect Rule in the dashboard.
